value.rationale: Prescribing exact fixed positions, not just their number, creates a sharp and potentially order-n^2 variation in expected inversions. The theorem completely identifies the unique maximizing centered set and all k+1 minimizing sets, yielding a natural spatial extremal classification not supplied by the fixed-count bivariate generating function.
